# Joshua Gatewood

> AI Engineer at Brinker. I build autonomous AI systems and full-stack platforms, and deliver production websites for clients.

## About

I'm an AI Engineer at Brinker. I started in marketing ops, then picked up AI coding tools and realized I could build what I used to only spec out. On my own, I built a field-operations platform for a construction company that was acquired, I'm building a content and distribution engine, and I deliver production websites for clients.

## Projects

### UGM Field Ops (Acquired)
- Status: Acquired
- Description: Full-stack field operations platform for a construction company. Real-time budget tracking, mobile clock-in/out, foreman approval workflow, AI-powered insights, and offline-first for remote job sites. Acquired by a company about six weeks after launch. Replaced manual data entry that was costing the company $26K-$39K/year in labor.

### Content Engine (In Progress)
- Status: Building
- Description: An AI system that turns trend signals and a single idea into voice-matched, publish-ready content and handles distribution across channels, with a human-approval queue. It grew out of an earlier multi-agent system Josh built across sales, marketing, and operations; he is now focused on the content and distribution layer.

### US Gage (Client Work)
- Status: Completed engagement (redesign not launched publicly)
- Description: Full digital transformation for a precision thread-gauge manufacturer (whose customers include GE Aerospace and BAE Systems). Website redesign, Google Ads optimization (health score 22 to 50, optimization score 71% to 90%), full analytics infrastructure (GA4 + GTM + GSC), brand strategy, competitive analysis, and WooCommerce e-commerce integration.

### Samco FM (Client Work)
- [samcofm.com](https://samcofm.com)
- Status: Live
- Description: Website, mobile app (iOS), and full SEO/AEO strategy for commercial HVAC company. Ranked on Google's first page within a week. #1 in Perplexity, visible in ChatGPT and Grok.

### Gauntlet AI (Marketing Operations)
- Status: Past role
- Description: Marketing operations for an established AI company. Full-funnel audit and roadmap that contributed to 2x pipeline growth, CRM cleanup with 4,400+ data issues resolved, content automation that lifted team output 3-5x, and competitive intelligence.
